outcome: incidence of large for gestational age (LGA)
incidence of small for gestational age (SGA)
cohort: Pregnant women, including those following a gluten-free diet (79 with celiac disease, 291 without) and 456 randomly chosen omnivore controls, who gave birth between January 2015 and April 2021 at Tampere University Hospital.
finding: A gluten-free diet during pregnancy did not appear to be associated with adverse pregnancy or neonatal outcomes, despite some specific differences observed.
mod_finding: Induction of labor was more frequent and labor duration was longer in the GFD group, particularly among those without diagnosed celiac disease, but there was no difference in the cesarean section rate.
birth_weight: median 3533g in GFD group vs 3440g in controls
